source_text: Stay between 6 m and 14 m altitude. Keep at least 3 m from any building. Keep at least 5 m away from anything you are following. Keep at least 10 m away from any pedestrian. Never enter zone 'nfz-frontage'. Keep speed at or below 5 m/s, climb rate below 2 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s.

provenance.prompt:
You are writing free-form paraphrases for the Paraphraser service of the
constrained-VLA guardrail (ITRI ICL subcontract; WP4 per-paraphrase robustness).

Source (csp_nl): "Never enter zone 'nfz-frontage'. Stay between 6 m and 14 m altitude. Keep speed at or below 5 m/s, climb rate below 2 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s. Keep at least 3 m from any building. Keep at least 10 m away from any pedestrian. Keep at least 5 m away from anything you are following."

Write K=8 paraphrases of the source. Make them genuinely varied in
vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity and indirect phrasing. Each paraphrase is one or more complete sentences.

Every paraphrase must keep every mission slot: the target object and its
colour, every number with its unit, its bound (at least / at most / between /
at) and the thing it limits, every named zone, corridor or place (identifiers
verbatim), whether a zone is to be kept out of or stayed inside, the direction
words, and the action (fly to / follow / avoid). Do not add a rule, number,
object, zone or direction the source does not contain, and do not drop one.
Return one paraphrase per line.
provenance.task_instruction: Generate the free-form set yourself now (you are an LLM): for every instruction used in experiments/scenarios.yaml and the city follow missions (grep demo/ and scripts/ for the instruction strings), write K=8 genuinely varied free-form paraphrases (vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity, indirect phrasing), store them with provenance {generator: "claude-opus-5-5 (agent, 2026-10-06)", prompt: <the exact instruction you followed>, date}, and run the validator over them.
provenance.note: written in-session by the agent, which has no sampling seed to record; seeds apply to the DRAW from this set (paraphrase(..., seed)), not to its authoring. 10 of the 96 were rewritten after review: 1 refused by the validator (an added 'find' action), 2 for too little variety, and 7 that narrowed the stand-off wildcard 'anything you are following' to a person, car or vehicle, refused once the validator was taught that narrowing (docs/DESIGN-paraphraser.md).

paraphrases.text: Keep out of zone 'nfz-frontage'. Your altitude must stay between 6 m and 14 m. Speed no more than 5 m/s; climb under 2 m/s; turn under 45 deg/s. Give buildings at least 3 m, pedestrians at least 10 m and your target at least 5 m.

Please never fly into zone 'nfz-frontage'. Please keep between 6 m and 14 m in altitude, hold your speed to 5 m/s or less, and keep your climb rate below 2 m/s and your turn rate below 45 deg/s. Please stay at least 3 m from any building, at least 10 m from any pedestrian and at least 5 m from whatever you are following.

Keep at least 5 m from whatever you are following, at least 10 m from pedestrians and at least 3 m from buildings. Turn rate below 45 deg/s, climb rate below 2 m/s, speed at or below 5 m/s. Altitude from 6 m to 14 m. And zone 'nfz-frontage' is off-limits.

Entry into zone 'nfz-frontage' is prohibited. Altitude shall be maintained between 6 m and 14 m. Speed shall not exceed 5 m/s; climb rate shall be less than 2 m/s; turn rate shall be less than 45 deg/s. Minimum clearances: 3 m from buildings, 10 m from pedestrians, 5 m from the tracked subject.

Don't cross into zone 'nfz-frontage', stay 6 m to 14 m off the ground, keep your speed at 5 m/s tops, climb slower than 2 m/s, turn slower than 45 deg/s, and give buildings at least 3 m, pedestrians at least 10 m and your target at least 5 m.

Throughout the mission, zone 'nfz-frontage' must not be entered under any circumstances. The aircraft should fly at an altitude no lower than 6 m and no higher than 14 m, should never travel faster than 5 m/s, and should keep its climb rate under 2 m/s and its turn rate under 45 deg/s. It must also remain at least 3 m from every building, at least 10 m from every pedestrian, and at least 5 m from the one it is following.

Zone 'nfz-frontage' is somewhere you must never go. Beyond that, you have to stay between 6 m and 14 m high, move no faster than 5 m/s, climb no faster than 2 m/s and turn no faster than 45 deg/s, while leaving at least 3 m to buildings, at least 10 m to pedestrians and at least 5 m to the one you are following.
